question: Fill in the blank (1) with the appropriate word from the options below:
solution:
The correct answer is** Option 3.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**gravity**" means the seriousness or importance of a situation. (गंभीरता)
 
• The context of climate change warrants** a term that conveys seriousness and urgency.**
 
• The other options: "**complexity**," "**absurdity**," and "**amenity**" do not convey the appropriate level of seriousness for the issue presented.
 
• ​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

**Complete Sentence:** The gravity__ of this problem can no longer be denied, as we witness more frequent and severe weather events.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Complexity (जटिलता)**: means the state of being complex or having many intricate parts.
 
• **Absurdity (बेतुकापन)**: means the quality of being ridiculous or wildly unreasonable.
 
• **Amenity (सुविधा)**: means a desirable or useful feature or facility of a place.
